title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1980-09-26
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
source: SBD > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90)

ai_review.summary: Crisp early‑Mydland soundboard captures a long, acoustic‑heavy first set highlighted by Ripple and a harpsichord‑like China Doll.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard tape from the early Brent Mydland era, offering clear instrument separation and a pleasant “harpsichord” texture on China Doll. Fans rave about the unusually acoustic first set that closes with a beautiful Ripple, making this a standout Warfield show despite its modest length of notes in the review.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed five‑star review praises both the performance (acoustic first set, standout Ripple and China Doll) and the crisp soundboard source, indicating a high‑quality show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with good instrument separation; early Mydland era keyboard texture noted as pleasant.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic‑focused first set that transitions into a shorter electric second set; long (3½–4 hr) show praised for its pacing and unique acoustic opening.

band_member_comments.Keys: Nice harpsichord‑like keyboard texture on China Doll, characteristic of the early Mydland era.
